title: Off-World Interceptor Extreme
overview:
Story mode offers 26 levels of brutality with password support. Blast across rugged 3D texture-mapped terrain as you blow away huge bosses.

Off-World Interceptor Extreme is an action driving game of car-to-car combat. You tear across rough terrain on worlds around the galaxy in a heavily armed 4x4 monster truck, shooting down rivals and collecting cash to buy better engines and jump jets that send your truck flying through the air. Switch between cockpit and chase views on the fly, and watch video scenes mocked by two wisecracking hosts.

- 26-level story mode with passwords
- Upgrade your truck with engines and jump jets
- Head-to-head split-screen mode for two players
